documents.title: API boundary policy
documents.body: The ingress adapter validates requests before application services and records a boundary decision for audit.

documents.title: Retry policy
documents.body: Transient calls use capped exponential backoff and a retry budget so a failing dependency cannot exhaust the worker.

documents.title: Cache invalidation rule
documents.body: Invalidate entries after configuration changes, record the reason, and publish a cache refresh event for observers.

documents.title: Cache incident runbook
documents.body: Inspect stale entries, restore the previous configuration, verify service health, and document the recovery result.

documents.title: Release gate
documents.body: A release requires reviewer signoff, a rollback note, and a verification step before publication.

documents.title: Rollback note
documents.body: When a verification step fails, stop publication, restore the last approved revision, and notify the reviewer.

documents.title: Support ownership matrix
documents.body: The support matrix assigns an owner, an escalation window, and a customer-facing communication path.

documents.title: Archive policy
documents.body: Archive records after the approved retention period and preserve the original locator with the archive decision.

documents.title: Archive review workflow
documents.body: Review the retention decision, confirm the owner, record an exception when needed, and then archive the item.

documents.title: Snapshot note
documents.body: A snapshot records a timestamp and a content digest so a later review can compare the approved state.
